subject: English Football
author: ZombieTron
body:
At work yesterday I was the only person who was pessimistic about our chances for qualification. I didn't watch the match, but I did flip onto it now and then. First flip 0 - 2, Second flip 2 - 2, Third flip 2 -3! haha!

oh well at least we got rid of Steve McClaren, never should of hired him in the first place but anyways.

How did Wales get on Boot??? haha 🙂
